## The question

During the COVID-19 pandemic, some organizations adapted and even innovated while others struggled. **What aspects of organizational culture separated the two?**

## The study

- **Survey:** a 70-item survey covering culture, climate, performance, COVID-19 responses, values, and social justice practices (Likert-scale and open-ended items)
- **Sample:** 241 respondents from more than 200 organizations across six continents, including HR/OD and non-HR professionals and roles from individual contributor to executive
- **Collection:** six weeks of snowball sampling through professional networks and social media
- **Framework:** gothamCulture's *Culture Mosaic*, which scores four culture dimensions: Inspire, Deliver, Enable, and Adapt

## Key findings

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| fig-alt: "Bar chart: organizations that innovated during COVID-19 scored higher on Enable (79 vs 61) and Adapt (78 vs 53)."
library(ggplot2)

scores <- data.frame(
  dimension = rep(c("Enable", "Adapt"), each = 2),
  group = rep(c("Reduced ability to innovate", "Pivoted / innovated"), 2),
  score = c(61, 79, 53, 78)
)
scores$group <- factor(scores$group, levels = c("Reduced ability to innovate", "Pivoted / innovated"))

p <- ggplot(scores, aes(dimension, score, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = score), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#9aa5b1", "#2c7be5")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 90), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Average Culture Mosaic score", fill = NULL,
       title = "Organizations that innovated during COVID-19 scored higher",
       caption = "Source: 2021 State of Culture Report (gothamCulture)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())

ggsave("thumbnail.png", p, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 100, bg = "white")
p
```

- **Culture predicted adaptability.** Organizations that pivoted or innovated during the pandemic scored significantly higher on all four Culture Mosaic dimensions, for example Enable (79 vs. 61) and Adapt (78 vs. 53).
- **Defining culture matters.** Organizations with a shared definition of culture, especially one shaped by leadership, scored significantly higher on all four dimensions. Only 44% had one.
- **Measurement isn't action.** Only 36% formally measured culture, and just 21% said their assessments led to real change, a clear gap between data and action.
- **Remote work is here to stay.** 68% expected remote work to continue after the pandemic.
- **Social justice:** organizations that discussed social justice openly and honestly significantly outperformed those that treated it as "lip service."
